# hcloudplus_user (Data Source)

The authenticated user (account owner). Reads GET /_user on the Hetzner Cloud Console private API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hcloudplus_user" "me" {}

output "caller_email" {
  value = data.hcloudplus_user.me.email
}
```
